Gold Appraisal Leads Atlanta

If you’re a jeweller, estate buyer or appraiser in Atlanta, CaratBase gives you verified local leads from people ready to sell gold or request an appraisal. Get the first three leads for free, then pay $40 for each accepted lead.

How It Works

  1. Sign up in seconds – No account creation required to start receiving leads.
  2. Receive verified contacts – Each lead is confirmed to be a genuine prospect looking to sell gold or get an appraisal.
  3. Accept or decline – Choose the leads that fit your business and close the sale.

What You Get

  • Immediate access to a pipeline of local prospects.
  • No upfront cost – First three leads are free.
  • Pay only for results – $40 per accepted lead.
  • Optional valuation widget – Add a simple appraisal tool to your website for $29/month.

Why Choose CaratBase

  • Local focus – All leads are from the Atlanta area, ensuring high relevance.
  • Verified quality – CaratBase screens each contact to reduce wasted time on unqualified prospects.
  • Transparent pricing – You pay only when a lead turns into a sale.

FAQ

Q: Does CaratBase provide gold appraisal leads in Atlanta? A: Yes, CaratBase specializes in delivering local leads for gold appraisal services in the Atlanta metro area.

Q: How much does it cost to use CaratBase? A: The first three leads are free. After that, each accepted lead costs $40. The optional valuation widget for your website is $29 per month.

Q: Do I need to create an account to start? A: No. You can begin receiving leads immediately without an account.
